description: Add the PATIENTENCOUNTER columns and the ADMISSIONCHARGEITEM table that shipped without a migration, if missing
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
preRequisites: Run migration.sql by hand on the database BEFORE deploying a build that maps these fields. The migration page only gets this file in that same build, so it cannot run this step first.
Idempotent; changes no data. Every new column is nullable (flags and amounts default to 0).
rollbackNotes: rollback.sql changes nothing: the columns and table may have existed before this migration and hold data. Drop them by hand only after checking.
